[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 130
- Description: Direction, review + approval for the Napa/Sonoma winery channel build
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/go_to_market/pull/193
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/go_to_market/pull/195
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/go_to_market/pull/196
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/go_to_market/pull/197
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/go_to_market/pull/198
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/dapp_beta/pull/153
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/dapp_beta/pull/151
  
  Details:
  CONTRIBUTOR: Gary Teh
  
  SCOPE: Governor-side work on the winery channel — strategic direction, PR review/merge, bug report, and the production promotion decision.
  
  ## Contributions
  
  **1. Channel strategy — the product pivot**
  The decisive input was recognising that wineries are not a retail placement like apothecaries. Tasting rooms sell by the glass and by the tasting flight, not by the bag — so the cacao-bag pitch was the wrong instrument entirely. Direction given:
  - Pitch the **81% single-estate bar flight**, not cacao bags.
  - **Drop unstockable estates** — a catalogue the winery can't actually stock is noise.
  - **Oscar's Farm only** as the opening pitch (single-estate focus, not a spread).
  - **12-bar case** positioned as try-it / reorder-deeper — the natural opening order unit for a tasting room.
  
  This reframing is what made the 150 discovered rows addressable at all; without it the pipeline was populating names against a product that didn't fit the venue.
  
  **2. Review + merge of 6 PRs**
  - `go_to_market` #193 — Napa+Sonoma discovery (region, `--allow-type` allowlist, Winery shop type, workflow)
  - `go_to_market` #195 — 81% single-estate bar wholesale price list for the winery channel
  - `go_to_market` #196 — pitch 81% bar flight to wineries, not cacao bags
  - `go_to_market` #197 — pitch Oscar's Farm only, 12-bar opening order, drop unstockable estates
  - `go_to_market` #198 — position the 12-bar case as try-it / reorder-deeper
  - `dapp_beta` #153 / #151 — Winery shop type across the store dropdowns
  
  **3. DApp bug report — "Winery" missing from store dropdowns**
  Reported against the live pages. This surfaced that the shop-type lists are built two different ways across three pages, so the segment could not be selected in the UI even after the backend work landed — the channel was populated but unreachable from the DApp.
  
  **4. Production promotion approval**
  Reviewed the verification on `beta.dapp.truesight.me` (all 3 pages confirmed) and gave the explicit go for `sync_beta_to_prod(dapp_prod)` — the irreversible gate. Confirmed live in production afterwards on all three pages.
  
  ## Time accounting
  Governor time is harder to bound than build time — no commit trail for thinking and review. Estimate below is a reconstruction.
  
  | Phase | Estimate |
  |---|---|
  | Channel strategy + product pivot (81% bar flight, Oscar's Farm, 12-bar unit) | 75 min |
  | PR review + merge across 6 PRs | 30 min |
  | DApp bug report + beta verification | 15 min |
  | Production promotion decision | 10 min |
  | **Total** | **130 min (2h 10m)** |
  
  ## Note
  The 150-row pipeline is at status `Research` — not yet contacted. Direction and build are complete; outreach is the next unit of work and is not claimed here.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 216.67
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
